description: Rental prices of GPUs beyond the index (RTX 5090, RTX 4090, L40S, RTX 6000 Ada, RTX A6000, A40, L4, GH200, V100 and about 30 more): each model's lowest, median and highest price per GPU-hour today as posted, its offers, how many are in stock, its providers and the cheapest, from RunPod, Vast.ai, Akash, Shadeform's catalog of clouds and Lium. Give a GPU for its daily history. Not an index: configurations are not standardized (the seven indexed GPUs are in get_gpu_prices).

gpu.description: A GPU model, e.g. "RTX 5090" or "L40S"; omit for all.
